children.text: Meetily is GDPR and HIPAA compliant by design (architecture-level). We do not claim independent SOC 2, GDPR, or HIPAA certification - those are organizational designations the deploying enterprise holds. BAA available on Enterprise. Custom pricing on all Enterprise plans.
What IT, security, and procurement teams ask before standing up Meetily Enterprise

children.q: Can Meetily Enterprise be self-hosted on our own infrastructure?
children.a: Yes. Meetily Enterprise deploys inside your environment - on-premise, in your AWS / Azure / GCP account, or in an EU data center of your choice (Hetzner, OVH, LeaseWeb). The trust boundary is yours, not a vendor's. Recording stays on the user's device, and any backend services (admin dashboard, audit log store, optional cloud LLM gateway) sit inside the perimeter you operate.

children.q: What does the admin dashboard cover?
children.a: Centralized user provisioning, license assignment, RBAC, retention policy configuration, audit log viewer (who recorded what, when, on which device), usage analytics, and deployment health. Built for an IT or security admin to operate without engineering support.

children.q: What kind of SLA and support do you offer?
children.a: Enterprise plans include 24/7 priority support, a named account manager, white-glove deployment assistance, and an SLA matched to the deployment tier. Specific uptime, response, and resolution targets are agreed in the contract; we do not publish a one-size-fits-all SLA because self-hosted deployments depend on your infrastructure.

Custom pricing only - it depends on user count, deployment model (on-prem vs your cloud), compliance framework requirements, and SLA tier. Click 'Talk to Us' on this page to book a demo and we will scope a quote within one business day.
